mainEntity.name: What is a crypto marketing agency in India and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A crypto marketing agency in India handles PR, KOL campaigns and community growth for Web3 projects that want to reach Indian investors, builders and retail audiences. It is for Indian-founded projects raising visibility domestically and for global projects entering the Indian market. A fractional senior operator like Shilika Jain provides the same service for $5K–$12K/month, without the overhead of a full agency team.

mainEntity.name: How much does crypto marketing cost for India-focused projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full-service agency retainer covering PR and KOL typically runs $15K–$45K/month. A fractional senior operator runs the same senior scope for $5K–$12K/month. A focused India launch sprint including PR and a KOL wave runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks. KOL fees range from $200–$1.5K for nano creators to $25K–$100K+ for macro influencers with large verified communities.

mainEntity.name: What is the process and timeline for a crypto marketing campaign in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical engagement starts with a one-week positioning audit, followed by a two-week narrative and outreach build, then a launch week with simultaneous press and KOL activation. Ongoing retainer work runs monthly. The highest-leverage window is six to twelve weeks before a public moment, such as a raise, mainnet or TGE.
